answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 5608 Country: India Title: What is the sunnah regarding drinking of water immediately at the end of a meal? Did our prophet PBUH abstain from drinking water after the meals? Question: What is the sunnah regarding drinking of water immediately at the end of a meal? Did our prophet PBUH abstain from drinking water after the meals? Answer ID: 5608 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 762/623 =B/1429) We have not seen a Hadith saying that the Prophet ( صلى الله ع لی ه وسلم ) used to take water just after meal or during meal. But it is understood by this prayer: الحمد لله الذي اطعمنا و سقانا و جعلنا مسلمين that some water should be taken during eating food. If a man feels thirsty, he may drink water just after eating. It is stated in the Hadith that fire was not lit in oven for months in the house of the Prophet ( صلى الله ع لی ه وسلم ), he used to live only on dates and water, but there is no clarification whether he drank water while eating dates or later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
